secrets.name: DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN
secrets.description: Discord bot token. Discord Developer Portal → your application → Bot → Reset Token, then copy it.

secrets.name: DISCORD_GUILD_ID
secrets.description: Optional. Discord server (guild) ID the bot answers in. Leave empty to answer in every server it is invited to.

secrets.name: POLLINATIONS_TOKEN
secrets.description: Optional. Free token from pollinations.ai that lifts the image API's anonymous rate limit. Without it, image creation often fails with 402.
